hypothesis: Configuring the locked 60 Hz fixed timestep before FStartPIECommand, rather than on the first capture-command update after PIE startup, eliminates the recurring two-state first-policy snapshot bifurcation without changing controller behavior or causal standing performance.

single_variable.name: causal_standing_fixed_step_activation_order
single_variable.control: Configure fixed timestep inside FCausalStandingCaptureCommand after PIE has started.
single_variable.candidate: Configure fixed timestep in a dedicated latent command before FStartPIECommand and restore it after FEndPlayMapCommand.

falsification: Any changed controller source file outside the causal-standing test harness.
Any remaining multiple first-policy snapshot hash families in Normal or ZeroActions.
Any locked bundle failure or causal ratio above 0.8.
Any destructive control losing its intended discrimination.
next_if_supported: Use the corrected deterministic harness to rerun E41 DistalHands, then continue remaining joints.
next_if_falsified: Instrument the pre-PIE/PIE startup frame chronology and physics initialization order; do not reinterpret joint restoration failures as deterministic.
